handler.command: FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; EXT="${FILE##*.}"; if [ "$EXT" = "rs" ]; then cd /root/agentforge-rs && cargo check 2>&1 | tail -3; fi
echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '(config/agentforge\.yaml|\.env|deploy/systemd/)' && echo 'BLOCKED: 生产配置文件禁止修改' && exit 2 || exit 0
cd /root/agentforge-rs && cargo check 2>&1 | tail -3; if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo '编译未通过，不能停止'; exit 1; fi
